Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today. We’d like to follow up with a 60-minute technical fit session to walk our engineers through expected traffic patterns, network/VPC options, and latency/cost tradeoffs. Primary goals: confirm feasibility for a private VPC deployment, discuss KV cache sizing for bursty telemetry, and validate rollout strategy for model variants.

Attendees from Acera (we’ll have 3): Priya Desai (platform lead), Tom Wu (infra), and one of our SREs.

Our availability next week (PT):
- Wed 20 Jan: 09:00–11:00
- Thu 21 Jan: 13:00–16:00
- Fri 22 Jan: 10:00–12:00

Can you propose a 60-minute slot that works for your pre-sales engineer and an account manager? Also, if you have a short agenda and a network checklist we can pre-check with our cloud team, please send that along.

Thanks —
Priya
